changelog:
- Advanced Real-Time Intelligence & Social Media Aggregation: Ask AI queries now capture and prioritize both verified journalism and breaking social media posts (Reddit, X, Bluesky, Threads, Instagram, YouTube clips) with intelligent query distillation and entity typo correction.
- Master Ad Blocker Toggle on Bottom Menu: The Ad Blocker button beside Fokk Mesh now acts as an instant master switch controlling the whole ad blocker. Easily toggle off when encountering anti-adblock warnings or site breakage, and re-enable with full Brave Rust shield power.
- Streamlined UI: Completely removed Media, Gestures & PiP hub from menu and eliminated the video logo and PiP icon from the command card bar for a cleaner, clutter-free browsing experience.
